caption:
✍️ -ing words aren't main verbs

✅ Rule: A sentence needs a real verb, not just an -ing form.
❌ The scientist, after years of study, publishing her results.
✅ The scientist, after years of study, published her results.
✅ Quick check: Cross out the middle. Is there a verb left?
